name: claude
label: Claude Code
notes: Tested with Claude Code 2.1.283. '--tools ""' removes every built-in tool and '--allowedTools mcp__vornfall' permits the game's tools even in a folder Claude Code has not been asked to trust (it ignores a project's permissions.allow there). claudeMdExcludes keeps your personal ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md out of the agent's context; autoMemoryEnabled false turns off auto-memory. The deny list is a second layer for older versions.
